_note: Role select content. Text is invented and should be reviewed by the team.

items.name: Science Lead
items.summary: Decide what to study and how to get the data home.
learn: How instruments turn power and time into data
items.difficultyHint: Gentle start: most crises land on other seats.

items.name: Power & Life Support
items.summary: Keep the lights on and the crew breathing.
learn: Solar power, dust and long nights
items.difficultyHint: Hardest seat: most urgent events are yours.

items.name: Comms & Navigation
items.summary: Keep the link to Earth and get everyone where they need to go.
learn: Signal delay and the speed of light
items.difficultyHint: Medium: comms outages and radiation warnings.

items.name: Launch & Budget
items.summary: Pick the launcher, balance the books and keep the team together.

items.name: Mission Director
learn: How all the systems depend on each other
items.note: You control every system; no AI teammates.
